verdict.rationale: Veo is driven programmatically through the Gemini API. The ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/video page describes refining video results through the Interactions API, and community users report calling the model ID veo-2.0-generate-001 and spending GCP credit on API generations. However, the evidence never shows full endpoint, auth, or parameter reference documentation, probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and the docs carry a migration notice to other models to avoid service interruptions, which signals the API surface is unstable. missing for 10: evidenced API reference documentation (endpoints, auth, request/response schemas), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404), a stable non-deprecated API surface, independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end API workflow

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
